customers.evidence: The people we serve are at the heart of everything we do.

employees.evidence: Our associates have deep home improvement experience and training

shareholders.evidence: build a sustainable foundation for growth

result.analyst_notes: Mostly factual and numbers-led, with a customer-first opening framed in first-person plural. Service and expertise are presented as capabilities rather than hedged aspirations. Stakeholder emphasis is customers, then associates. Community and growth appear only briefly, and the strategy section lists pillars without elaboration.
